why: MFCRT is a named culturally responsive teaching framework for operationalizing motivational conditions, not a general explanatory learning theory.
name: Motivational Framework for Culturally Responsive Teaching (MFCRT)
product_description: A framework developed by Wlodkowski and Ginsberg for designing culturally responsive instruction through the motivational conditions of inclusion, attitude, meaning, and competence.

why: M-FP is a named, adoptable mindfulness curriculum package with a defined eight-session sequence and prescribed home practices, applied here to a particular population.
name: Mindfulness: A Practical Guide to Finding Peace in a Frantic World (M-FP)
product_description: An introductory, skills-based mindfulness curriculum developed from mindfulness-based cognitive therapy that sequences four themes across eight sessions and includes daily home practice for general adult learners.

why: MFAS-CCSS is a named formative-assessment system comprising tasks, rubrics, professional development, and implementation supports, not a general learning theory.
name: Mathematics Formative Assessment System (MFAS-CCSS)
product_description: A mathematics formative-assessment system developed by Laura B. Lang and colleagues that provides Common Core–aligned tasks and rubrics, together with professional-development and implementation supports, for elementary teachers.

why: The MFCS is a technology-specific implementation of Multimedia Instruction because it coordinates live practical demonstrations with multiple visual displays and recorded video, rather than constituting a distinct instructional element.

rejected.verifier: The claim reports group differences in SOAP scores without directly identifying multimedia instruction as the tested practice.
The claim concerns a combined instructional intervention and its assessment outcomes, not the use of coordinated multimedia representations itself.
